title: Implement branding extraction (colors, fonts, logo from homepage HTML)
description: Implement src/scraper/branding.ts which extracts brand colors, fonts, and logo URL from the raw HTML of the homepage. This runs on the raw HTML before Cheerio strips style tags. Uses regex patterns — no API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: `extractBranding(rawHtml: string, pageUrl: string): BrandingData` function exists and works
Hex color codes are extracted from CSS (e.g., `#2563eb`, `#fff`)
RGB/RGBA colors are extracted and converted to hex
Font family names are extracted from font-family declarations and Google Fonts link tags
Logo URL is extracted from img tags near header or with 'logo' in src/alt/class
Returns deduplicated, non-trivial colors (excludes white, black, near-white, near-black)
Returns empty arrays/null gracefully if nothing is found

steps.details: Create `extractBranding(rawHtml: string, pageUrl: string): BrandingData`. Import `BrandingData` from `./types`.

steps.description: Extract hex and RGB colors from CSS
steps.details:
Apply regex to the full rawHtml string:
- Hex colors: `/#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})\b/g` 
- RGB: `/rgb\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*\)/g`
Convert RGB to hex. Deduplicate. Filter out near-white (#f8f8f8 and above) and near-black (#111 and below) and pure white/black. Return up to 5 most unique colors.

Two approaches:
1. CSS font-family declarations: `/font-family\s*:\s*([^;"'{}]+)/gi` — extract family names, split by comma, clean quotes.
2. Google Fonts URL: `/fonts\.googleapis\.com\/css[^"']*family=([^"'&]+)/g` — decode the font names from the URL param.
Deduplicate and return clean font names (remove generic families like 'sans-serif', 'serif', 'monospace').

Use Cheerio to parse rawHtml. Look for img tags that satisfy any of: `src` contains 'logo', `alt` contains 'logo' (case-insensitive), `class` contains 'logo', or the img is inside a `<header>` or element with class/id containing 'header'. Return the first match's absolute URL. Resolve relative URLs against pageUrl.

steps.description: Wire branding extraction into the crawl service
steps.details: In `crawlee-service.ts`, after collecting all pages, call `extractBranding(homepageRawHtml, url)` on the first page's raw HTML. Include the result in the return value alongside the pages array.

technicalNotes: Run branding extraction on raw HTML BEFORE passing to Cheerio for text extraction — Cheerio strips style tags.
Color filtering: remove colors that are too light (luminance > 0.9) or too dark (luminance < 0.05) since these are background/text defaults, not brand colors.
Logo URL must be absolute. Use `new URL(relativeSrc, pageUrl).href` to resolve relative paths.
This is a best-effort extraction — many sites won't have easily extractable branding. Graceful fallback to AI-suggested palette is handled in TASK-48.
